uniqueIntro: Need an affordable, agile man and van service in Birmingham? Jimmys Removals provides flexible hourly or fixed-rate man and van bookings across the city. Whether you are moving a studio flat in Digbeth, buying furniture on Facebook Marketplace, or relocating a student room in Selly Oak, we provide the muscle and modern transport.
localAngle: Our man and van fleet is 100% Clean Air Zone compliant, allowing free transit across the A4540 Middleway without daily emissions penalties. We offer 1, 2, or 3 working movers depending on your requirements.

faqs.question: Is your Birmingham man and van service compliant with the Clean Air Zone?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our vans meet Euro 6 standards, so you will never pay CAZ surcharges in central Birmingham.

faqs.question: What is the minimum booking period for man and van in Birmingham?
faqs.answer: Our minimum booking period is 2 hours, billed in clear 30-minute increments thereafter.

faqs.question: Can I travel in the van cab with the driver?
faqs.answer: Subject to advance notice and seatbelt availability, one passenger may accompany the driver.

faqs.question: Do you help with lifting heavy items like sofas and appliances?
faqs.answer: Yes, our drivers and porters actively load, carry, secure, and unload all agreed items.
